purpose: Equivalent magnetic-lattice input for the M0-M4 spin models; a full atomic CIF is not required because only Co magnetic-site displacement vectors enter the spin Hamiltonian and dipolar Ewald sum.

public_source.title: Field-tuned incommensurate fan phase in an Ising-like triangular antiferromagnet

source_locations.interlayer_bond_convention: main.tex Fig. 9 and Eq. for interplane exchange; implemented and unit-tested in stacked_lattice.py

magnetic_lattice.origin_convention: Origin placed on Co; translations generate the complete magnetic sublattice.

cif_status.note: The preserved Oxford ORA archive contains figure-level diffraction data and calculations but no CIF. The explicit magnetic-lattice representation above is the equivalent input required by the frozen model specification.
